shared_elements: low-relief figures carved against a plain ground
horizontal band/register containing a row of repeated small motifs
compartmentalised fields of small repeated signs or forms
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry flat low-relief imagery organised with a horizontal upper band of repeated small motifs above larger figural elements, and both include profile animal-like heads. Beyond that the content diverges completely: A shows an elaborately costumed standing human figure with headdress flanked by dense columns of rectangular script-like signs, while B shows sparse, schematic animals (quadruped, birds, a snake-like form) and an abstract H-shaped sign on a plain field, with no human figure or writing.
